user_prompt: We need to pull together our supplier payment terms and current commitments against what we've got coming in from our clients this quarter—basically reconcile who we owe and what we're expecting to collect so we can forecast our cash position accurately.

steps.step_name: Pull together our supplier payment terms and current financial commitments we owe
Pull together our client invoices and expected collections coming in this quarter
Reconcile supplier obligations against client receivables to forecast our cash position
